blind.description: A decorative floor urn or vase holding an arrangement of feathery plumes or stylized autumn leaves. The vase has a bulbous green ceramic body with a flared lip, circular base, and gold/yellow drip-glaze detailing along the upper shoulder. The foliage consists of dense, stylized leaf-like or feather-like clusters in shades of orange, rust, and amber.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a star-shaped or radial rosette of orange spiky leaf clusters, casting a distinct vase-and-foliage shadow onto the floor.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.3 feet tall, reaching just below the knee/lower thigh of the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 1.2 feet wide at the plumes.

notes: Plumes are wider and more orange/rust toned than the requested cream sheaf, but reads clearly as intended background prop
